title: Fast-feedback standup log — UI rollouts & analytics (2026-03-24)
summary: Quick daily standup focused on two live rollouts (traffic-split canary) and a lightweight analytics backfill. Action items concentrated on fixing a dark-mode CSS regression, stabilizing the rollout observer metric pipeline, and a short lived canary rollback investigation.
notes:
TL;DR: Canary traffic split to new rollout-controller reached 20% overnight. We observed elevated 500s for the /api/rollout-state endpoint between 03:00-03:40 UTC; traffic autoscaled but error rate concentrated on older dedicated config paths. Mateo identified a malformed header in the reconciliation loop from the controller side - PR opened.

Detailed: 
- Rollout health: Canary was healthy for page render but API error spike affected rollback button on UI. No customer-facing outages recorded. Noah confirmed SLO not yet breached (0.5% window).
- Analytics: Eve ran a one-off backfill to populate rollout_latency_percentiles for the last 72 hours into the new materialized view. Backfill completed at ~10:20 PT, but the job produced duplicated rows for sessions with empty request_id; she added a dedupe step to the job.
- UI: Priya flagged a visual regression in dark mode where badge contrast dropped after PR #1887 merged (scoping to CSS variables). This affects rollout variant chip and makes it hard to read percentage during canary splits.
- Observability: New 'rollout.observer.lag' metric is noisy when the analytics consumer falls behind; Noah suggested smoothing and alert after 5m sustained lag > 30s.
- Docs: Liam will update the rollout-playback runbook to include troubleshooting steps for header mismatches and quick rollback via routing policy toggle.

Meeting fragments / raw notes: 
- "if we pin to stable-config it avoids header drift" - Mateo
- "backfill dedupe okay but we should add schema check in pre-hook" - Eve
- "canary UI needs an explicit status badge for API errors" - Priya
- "set alert to 5m continuous lag, not single spike" - Noah
decisions: Pause canary traffic at 20% until PR #1892 fixes header encoding in controller
Add dedupe step and schema pre-check to analytics backfill job before next run
Create a temporary UI error badge for canary variants to highlight API errors independent of render success
action_items: Mateo: finish and merge PR #1892 to normalize headers in rollout-controller by 2026-03-25
Priya: ship CSS patch for dark-mode badge contrast (hotfix) and add visual test by 2026-03-25
Eve: update backfill job with dedupe and schema validation; re-run for last 7 days if clean by 2026-03-26
Noah: change alert policy for rollout.observer.lag to 5m sustained >30s and add dashboard panel
Liam: update rollout-playbook page with header-mismatch checklist and rollback steps, link to PRs
blockers: Need an infra approval to run the larger 7-day backfill due to read cost (finance approval pending)
Triage team requires confirmation that footer headers are not intentionally different for legacy customers
Design needs to sign off on the temporary error badge before shipping to prod
next_meeting: 2026-03-26 10:00 PT - follow-up: verify merged fixes, re-evaluate canary progression, confirm analytics backfill status
